data.body: **P1:** A scope fatal is published before `closeHandlerScopes` finishes closing earlier scopes. Returning here skips the bounded handoff, allowing `onInvocationEnd` and plugin release to run while an earlier scope is still performing same-thread cleanup. This can end or flush a plugin while its handler context remains active. Perform the bounded `handlerFuture` wait before selecting the fatal result, and test two scopes where the later close throws fatally while the earlier close blocks.
